{{Top|leg}}
A '''portable commnet uplink''' was a communications device employed by the inhabitants of [[Rabaan]] and [[S'krrr]]. When [[the Combat]] was called, and chosen warriors fought on the [[Combat Moon]], each had one half of the portable commnet uplink. Once the combat had been settled, the victor took the half from the defeated loser to broadcast their victory to the [[Ishanna system/Legends|Ishanna system]].<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>
